site.name: sitekit
site.description: Design system and scaffold for documentation microsites on GitHub Pages.

hero.title: Documentation sites that look like a product.
hero.lede: A dark design system, a content pipeline that reads your repository, and a scaffold that publishes to GitHub Pages. MIT licensed.

features.title: Tokens and components you own
features.text: Components are copied into your site, shadcn style. Edit them freely. One tokens file drives every color, radius and font.

features.title: Docs from the files you already have
features.text: Markdown in docs, examples and the changelog becomes pages. Relative links keep working on GitHub and on the site.

features.title: A closed contract and a publish check
features.text: Unknown config keys fail the build. A scan looks for credentials and internal hosts before anything is deployed.

features.title: Static HTML, almost no JavaScript
features.text: Every route is a real HTML file with its own title. Only the copy buttons and the mobile menu ship JavaScript.

collections.label: Docs
collections.lede: Guides and reference for using sitekit.

collections.label: Examples
collections.lede: Working examples you can copy and adapt.
